question: Which materials are identified as suitable sources for ritual vessels addressed to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are named
Vessels born of tortoise are named
Vessels of bell metal and copper metal are named
inference: Ritual vessels may be made from clay, tortoise, bell metal, and copper metal
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'kūrmajaṃ' may be a tortoise-shell vessel
plain_english: O goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell metal, or born of copper metal.
